comparisons.peer_summary: On November 22, 2023, Broadcom acquired VMware in a cash-and-stock transaction, providing VMware stockholders with approximately $30,788 million in cash and 544 million shares of Broadcom common stock valued at $53,398 million.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclose significant cash-and-stock acquisitions as major strategic transactions impacting their capital resources. AMD acquired ZT Systems for approximately $3.4 billion in cash and stock, subject to additional contingent payments. Broadcom similarly acquired VMware for approximately $30.8 billion in cash and 544 million shares. Both disclosures detail the specific composition of consideration (cash vs. equity) and the timing of the deals, highlighting large-scale M&A activity as a key driver of capital allocation and liquidity planning.

sentences.text: Upon closing of the acquisition, we will pay approximately $3.4 billion in cash and 8,335,852 shares of AMD common stock and to the extent certain conditions are met, we will pay an additional $300 million of cash and up to 740,964 shares of AMD common stock.
The VMware stockholders received approximately $30,788 million in cash and 544 million shares of Broadcom common stock with a fair value of $53,398 million.
